podcast.body: The album's first single, where Mut Lang worked with Mick Jones to perfect the interplay of twangy guitars and ghostly synth riffs. Lang brought in legendary Motown saxophonist Junior Walker for a "smoking solo," painstakingly piecing it together from multiple takes. The song reached number four on the Hot 100 in the late summer of 1981, helping send the "4" album to number one. "On urgent, the album's first single, Mutt worked with Mick Jones to perfect the interplay of the Twangie guitars and ghostly synth riffs."
